pages.text: A Resonance Core floods power through connected Lumen Conduits (dead → dim → active) and opens the Ancient Doors they reach. Lumen Relays bridge gaps in the network.

A powered Gravity Lens lifts entities in the column above it — the same idea the $(l:liftshafts)Liftshafts$(/l) scale up. A dead city's Dormant Light Engine can be restored with a looted resonance core fragment, waking the network. Cores and lenses can be rebuilt from looted fragments.
